description: This file contains a Spark SQL example application demonstrating DataFrame and Dataset operations, schema inference, and programmatic schema creation in Scala.

classes.name: Person
classes.description: A case class representing a person with name and age fields.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method initializing SparkSession and running various Spark SQL example functions.

methods.name: runBasicDataFrameExample
methods.description: Demonstrates basic DataFrame operations including reading JSON, showing data, schema, filtering, grouping, and SQL views.

methods.name: runDatasetCreationExample
methods.description: Shows creating Datasets from case classes and JSON, and converting DataFrames to Datasets.

methods.name: runInferSchemaExample
methods.description: Illustrates schema inference from RDDs and SQL querying with schema.

methods.name: runProgrammaticSchemaExample
methods.description: Creates a DataFrame with a programmatically defined schema from an RDD and runs SQL queries.
